# ShipAI Lab - Complete Information

> AI SaaS & Product Development in 15 Days

## Company Overview

ShipAI Lab is a specialized AI development agency that builds and launches AI-powered SaaS, web, and mobile products in just 15 days. We offer fixed pricing, expert team support, and proven results for startups and businesses looking to bring their AI ideas to market quickly.

## Core Services

### 1. SaaS Platforms
Build scalable, user-friendly SaaS solutions tailored to your business needs. We handle:
- Architecture design and database modeling
- User authentication and authorization
- Payment integration and subscription management
- Admin dashboards and analytics
- API development and third-party integrations
- Scalable cloud infrastructure setup

### 2. Mobile & Web Apps
Create high-performance mobile and web apps designed for user engagement and success:
- Cross-platform mobile apps (iOS & Android)
- Progressive Web Apps (PWA)
- Responsive web applications
- Modern UI/UX design
- Real-time features and notifications
- App store deployment

### 3. AI-Powered Apps
Develop innovative AI applications to automate processes and drive business growth:
- Natural Language Processing (NLP) applications
- Computer Vision solutions
- AI content generation tools
- Machine Learning model integration
- AI automation workflows
- Custom AI chatbots and assistants

## Portfolio Projects

### NoMoreCopyRight
**URL:** https://nomorecopyright.com
**Description:** An AI tool that creates copyright-free images, videos, and music, combined with a free stock content platform. This comprehensive solution helps content creators avoid copyright issues by generating original media using AI.
**Technologies:** AI image generation, AI video creation, AI music composition, stock content platform
**Category:** AI Content Creation

### Reisknaller
**URL:** https://www.reisknaller.nl
**Description:** A Dutch travel platform offering unbeatable travel deals and packages. The platform aggregates and curates the best travel offers for Dutch travelers.
**Technologies:** Travel aggregation, deal curation, booking system
**Category:** Travel & Tourism

### StoryTyme
**URL:** https://storytyme.ai
**Description:** Create custom children's books in 5 simple steps. An AI-powered platform that generates personalized children's stories with custom characters, themes, and illustrations.
**Technologies:** AI story generation, AI illustration, personalization engine
**Category:** AI Education & Entertainment

### GetsweetAI
**URL:** https://getsweet.ai
**Description:** AI platform for social media automation. Automates content creation, scheduling, and engagement across multiple social media platforms using AI.
**Technologies:** AI content generation, social media APIs, automation workflows
**Category:** AI Marketing & Social Media

### SASGPT
**URL:** https://sasgpt.com
**Description:** SASGPT is an AI-powered SAS code editor that lets you write, generate, and analyze SAS code instantly. Designed for data analysts and statisticians working with SAS programming.
**Technologies:** AI code generation, SAS language processing, code analysis
**Category:** AI Development Tools

### Bevinzey
**URL:** https://bevinzey.com
**Description:** AI education assistant that helps students learn more effectively through personalized tutoring, homework help, and study materials generation.
**Technologies:** AI tutoring, personalized learning, educational content generation
**Category:** AI Education

### CookeAI
**URL:** https://cookeai.com
**Description:** AI-powered recipe generator that creates custom recipes based on available ingredients, dietary preferences, and cooking skill level.
**Technologies:** AI recipe generation, ingredient matching, nutritional analysis
**Category:** AI Food & Lifestyle
